author: AirPano VR
description:
Immerse yourself in a winter fairytale with our short video, where a snow-covered road gently meanders through a majestic forest, blanketed in snow-white trees. 

Every frame imbues the atmosphere with magic, like something out of a childhood dream book. The calm rhythm of a leisurely car ride creates a sense of comfort and peace, while the sounds of beautiful music gently enhance the magic of the winter landscape. 

This film is an invitation to take a break from the hustle and bustle and enjoy the beauty of nature in its full glory. Join us on this magical journey!

Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view.

If you enjoyed this video please like, share, comment, favorite, subscribe: https://goo.gl/NZMdaz 
We regularly publish new 360 videos of the most beautiful places on our planet!

360° photos and videos, stories of our shootings, articles and FAQ you can find on our website: http://AirPano.com

title: Winter Forest. VR road relaxation in 8K
